name: Trashless Traversal with Block Lists
definition: A traversal scheme ensuring data replaced in cache is not required again, avoiding cache trashing. It subdivides volume into blocks, sorts them front-to-back, and places them in block lists such that no ray intersecting one block in a list intersects another block in the same list.
summary: Trashless Traversal with Block Lists is a cache-oblivious volume rendering strategy that eliminates cache trashing by organizing sorted blocks into disjoint lists, ensuring no ray intersects multiple blocks within the same list.
